#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    bool res = true;
    while (m > 0) {
        int r = m % w;
        if (r == 0 || r - 1 == 0) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (r + 1 == w) {
            m++;
        } else {
            res = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << (res ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;

    return 0;
}
